description: This file manages Feishu thread bindings, including creating, listing, binding, unbinding, and state management for thread conversations within the Feishu channel. It provides functions to create managers, resolve binding IDs, and handle session bindings, with internal state stored in a global store.

classes.name: FeishuThreadBindingRecord
classes.description: Represents a thread binding record with details about the account, conversation, and session.

classes.name: FeishuThreadBindingManager
classes.description: Manages thread bindings for a specific Feishu account, including binding, unbinding, and state management.

classes.name: FeishuThreadBindingsState
classes.description: Holds the global state of all managers and bindings.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the global thread bindings state.

methods.name: resolveBindingKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for a binding based on accountId and conversationId.

methods.name: toSessionBindingTargetKind
methods.description: Converts raw Feishu target kind to generic BindingTargetKind.

methods.name: toFeishuTargetKind
methods.description: Converts generic BindingTargetKind to Feishu-specific target kind.

methods.name: toSessionBindingRecord
methods.description: Transforms a FeishuThreadBindingRecord into a SessionBindingRecord with expiration logic.

methods.name: createFeishuThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a thread binding manager for a given account and configuration.

methods.name: getFeishuThreadBindingManager
methods.description: Retrieves the existing thread binding manager for a given accountId.
